title: Verify: Submit validation, quota and submit-state unit tests
summary: Unit tests for validation and feedback with fetch mocked
description: Test empty, over-length, exhausted, loading, success and API error paths.
acceptance_criteria: Loading, success and error states asserted
technical_constraints: fetch stubbed with vi.stubGlobal; POST returns contributionFixture per tests/fixtures/api.ts (mirrors contributionJSON in backend/internal/contribution/handler.go)

steps.action: Create the file with jsdom env and a stubFetch helper. Render <ContributionSheet open onClose roundId=''> (empty id skips history). Test 1: click Send with empty textarea; assert alert 'Enter an idea before sending' and fetch not called. Test 2: change textarea to 'a'.repeat(501), click Send; assert alert contains '500 characters' and fetch not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionValidation.test.tsx -t "empty|over-length"

steps.action: Stub GET history to return 5 contributions built from contributionFixture with distinct prompts; render with roundId 'round-1'; await 'No contributions left'; assert textarea and Send button are disabled and fetch was called only for the history GET.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionValidation.test.tsx -t "exhausted"
steps.expected: Form disabled and no POST made

steps.symbol: test: loading, success and API error
steps.action: Success: POST resolves via a deferred promise; click Send with valid text; assert button is disabled with text 'Sending…', resolve, then assert role=status 'Idea sent'. Error: POST returns 429 JSON {error:'rate limited'}; assert alert 'Slow down, try again shortly'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionValidation.test.tsx -t "success|API error"
steps.expected: Loading, success and error states asserted
